Descriptor retention prevents inode reuse by a replacement after unlink.

checks.lease_and_lifetime: Borrowed lease not consumed; directoryfd validity/device/inode/type rechecked after observer before publication. Move-only Descriptor closes on every exit; prepared ConfigFile is noexceptmovable.
checks.outcome: Post-P directorysync failure returnsIo with explicit firstpublicationalreadyoccurred diagnostic. Success returns preallocated expected without successful-path allocation; adapter separatelyprepares shared baseline. No cancellation within lowlevel synchronous transaction.

limitations: Physical powerloss/disk durability is not demonstrated by source review or injected sync result.
Path checks plus rename are not an atomic source-inode CAS or exclusion against arbitrary noncooperating swaps; RENAME_NOREPLACE protects existing primary target only.
Successful creation does not promise absence of a backup introduced by another process after its final absence observation.
Observer is a deterministic diagnostic/fault seam; arbitrary throwing/reentrant observer exception safety or unbounded/globalOOM guarantees are not claimed.
Existing ProfileLease canonicalization/lock and old save semantics remain inherited, not strengthened.
